text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
*huff, puff*... Dia-chan... You've really 
caught up to me...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I felt Dia-chan's fighting spirit 
firsthand. My skin is still stinging from 
it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Me too. Kita-chan's fighting spirit was so 
hot, I felt like I was going to get 
scorched.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: So this is Dia-chan during a race...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: So this is Kita-chan during a race...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We can clash like this as many times as we 
want from now on, right, Dia-chan?! I 
can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I can run with Kita-chan as many 
times as I want!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Kitasan! I'll be cheering for 
you next time too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Do your best too, Diamond-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes!! Thank you so much, everyone! My next 
race is... the Osaka Hai!
(Ooooohhh!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Which means it's the Spring Senior Triple 
Crown! Let's go take it, Kitasan!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes! Everyone, please watch me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm running too! In the Osaka Hai!!

"We haven't discussed the next race yet, 
nor even our overall plan for the Senior 
Year."

However, after a quick glance my way, 
Satono Diamond turned back to the stands 
and repeated herself once more.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna take on Kita-chan at the Osaka 
Hai!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond versus Kitasan Black— will 
their duel continue?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is just the beginning... 
Ooooh! I'm gonna see this rivalry through 
to the very end!!

The roar of the crowd engulfs the stands, 
showing no sign of calming down. Just 
then, Kitasan Black calls all the 
participating Umamusume to gather close.

The Umamusume lined up in a row and looked 
up at the stands. Then, they raised both 
hands and waved them wide from side to 
side.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, please keep supporting us next 
year too!!
(WOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...I apologize for taking matters into my 
own hands.

The moment she returned to the waiting 
room, Satono Diamond bowed deeply.
choice_data_list:
Is the Osaka Hai really the right choice 
for our next goal?
Is the Osaka Hai okay for our next goal?

text_block_list.text:
There are no issues with the distance or 
timing. Just to be safe, I needed to make 
sure the decision aligned with her plan to 
become a legendary Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The Osaka Hai is a GⅠ race, so there 
is no problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Watching Kita-chan after the race today... 
I was reminded once again of just how 
incredible she is.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...I hadn't caught up to Kita-chan at 
all..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You saw it too, didn't you, Trainer? The 
smiles on the faces in the stands. The 
earth-shaking cheers.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
With her running, Kita-chan brings joy to 
everyone and livens up the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I felt that this was one form of a "great 
Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I still cannot clearly see what the ideal 
form of a "great Umamusume" should be.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
In Kita-chan's case, I believe she has an 
aura that makes people naturally want to 
cheer on her running.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Kita-chan's running is what captivates 
the fans and draws them all in."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...In my position as the young lady of the 
Satono family, I doubt I could ever spark 
such fervent passion.

An unwavering strength of will. She is one 
who is always noble, never revealing a 
trace of weakness.

Which makes it all the more frustrating 
that her efforts go unnoticed. She shines 
with a supreme radiance that easily rivals 
Kitasan Black's.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm happy to hear that... but I'm 
fine.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I intend to find my own way of being a 
"Great Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
How I, as Satono Diamond, can contribute 
to the Umamusume world...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
By watching how Kita-chan carries herself, 
and continuing to chase after her back... 
I feel like I'll be able to find my own 
way.
choice_data_list: Got it. Next up is the Osaka Hai!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Trainer, I look forward to working 
with you!

The ideal form of a "great Umamusume." 
Searching for an answer yet unseen, I 
shall forge ahead through the Senior Class 
with Satono Diamond.
